eligibility_reason: A theoretical reply to Knobe & Mendlow (2004). Its only data come from a new 'mini-study' with 44 undergraduates and two newly written cook-out vignettes (C1/C2, with C2 written with help from Al Mele). The study manipulates the agent's knowledge and desire while holding the bad side effect constant, to test an alternative 'desire plus knowledge' explanation that the author does not commit to (fn. 7). It is a new original experiment, not a repetition of any prior published finding, so it fits the commentary/theory genre with no qualifying replication entry.
